hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in .env|*/.env|*/evaluation/benchmarks/*/qrels.jsonl|*/evaluation/benchmarks/*/queries.jsonl|*/tests/fixtures/evaluation/*) echo "Blocked: $f is a protected secret or evaluation ground-truth file. Regenerate benchmarks with scripts.build_a1_benchmark, or ask the user to edit it directly." >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) out=$(ruff check --quiet --output-format concise "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'ruff found issues in %s:\n%s\n' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
